notes: BOUNTY-TRUST-BAN-20261011 supersedes earlier platform-wide GREEN instructions and any instruction to continue collection or bounty due diligence for excluded or unverified maintainers.

Default BLOCK covers all new and existing bounty discovery, due diligence, research, implementation, revisions, submissions, claims, collections, follow-ups, queued sends, retries, watchers, and local/cloud execution.

Only a documented exact-scope reputable proven maintainer or an established legitimate well-starred repository with our already-merged contribution qualifies. Stars alone, escrow, advertised rewards, or a third-party merge do not qualify.
Existing evidence-backed GREEN payout records remain the proven-payer route, subject to freshness, no unresolved overdue accepted bounty, current exact-task terms, and all other owner holds.
